info.title: About the Prime Score
info.p1: Your Prime Score shows how consistently you've followed through on the goals you chose over the last seven days.
info.p2: It's simple: completed check-ins divided by planned check-ins. Days before you started never count against you.
info.p3: It is not a measure of your health, your fitness or your worth. It's a gentle mirror for your own commitments, nothing more.
info.p4: If life gets busy, choose fewer goals. The score adapts to you, not the other way round.

tips.t1: Progress isn't a straight line. Showing up on an ordinary day is what makes the difference.
tips.t2: Your energy is information, not judgement. Adjust today's plan to fit how you feel.
tips.t3: Pair a new habit with something you already do, like a short stretch after your morning coffee.
tips.t4: Rest is part of the plan. Recovery is when your body and mind get stronger.
tips.t5: Notice one thing you did well yesterday. Confidence grows from evidence.
tips.t6: Make the next step so small it feels almost too easy. Then take it.
tips.t7: You've done hard things before. That strength is still yours.
